title: MM-OPD: Towards One More Bottleneck Between Perception and Reasoning
abstract_first: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance visual reasoning by strengthening both perception and reasoning, implicitly assuming a process that transitions seamlessly from perception to reasoning.
